original:
यतो धर्मस्ततो कृष्णो यतो कृष्णस्ततो जयः ।
इति मत्वा महाप्राज्ञ संदधुस्ते परस्परम् ॥
sanskrit:
यतो धर्मस्ततो कृष्णो यतो कृष्णस्ततो जयः ।
इति मत्वा महाप्राज्ञ संदधुस्ते परस्परम् ॥
transliteration:
yato dharmas tato kṛṣṇo yato kṛṣṇas tato jayaḥ |
iti matvā mahāprājña saṃdadhus te parasparam ||
translation: Where there is righteousness, there is Krishna; and where there is Krishna, there is victory.

layers.author: gita_press
layers.content: जहाँ धर्म है वहाँ श्रीकृष्ण हैं, और जहाँ श्रीकृष्ण हैं वहीं विजय है।

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: जिथे धर्म आहे तिथे श्रीकृष्ण आहेत, आणि जिथे श्रीकृष्ण आहेत तिथेच विजय निश्चित आहे.

layers.author: nilakantha
layers.content: The universal axiom uttered repeatedly by Sanjaya and Gandhari during peace embassies, establishing that Krishna embodies the moral order of the cosmos.

layers.author: km_ganguli
layers.content: The defining theme of Udyoga Parva as Sri Krishna serves as ambassador of peace while war preparations peak.
